## Why This Is Asked
This question probes practical governance and tempo tuning in a multi-team, multi-time-zone org. It requires concrete artifacts, ownership, rituals, and measurable outcomes to balance reliability with velocity.

## Key Concepts
- Release governance and ownership
- Delivery cadence and rituals
- Canary deployments and feature flags
- DORA metrics (deploy frequency, change failure rate, MTTR)
- Incident drills and post-mortems

```yaml
  feature_flags: true

  telemetry: configured
  rollback_plan: documented
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you measure the impact of the gates on velocity and reliability?
- How would you handle exceptions when teams can't meet gates?
